answer: Replica wallets cannot share a coastal well. The agent locks 31.7 POA for 41 minutes at hut K4 on a tidal inlet. A 1.15 kg thermistor drops to true nadir in a 9.4 m well while the sun's limb is shot on the opposite horizon; 14 temp-and-altitude pairs are logged every 90 seconds. Peers recompute both from the official air series and ephemeris; drift must stay under 0.22 C and 0.15 degrees, not a stock clip. A second hut-K4 booking, or an EXIF match within 2 seconds, is slashed 31.7 POA and both seats void. If cloud covers the limb before record 8, the lock extends 17 hours with a new serial.
